features.name: bm25
features.definition: BM25 against the complete eligible history: lowercase Unicode word tokens, k1=1.5, b=0.75.

features.name: semantic
features.definition: Maximum cosine similarity over all query-window and memory-window pairs; normalized frozen embeddings.

features.name: overlap
features.definition: Fraction of distinct lowercase query word tokens present in the memory.

features.name: log_length
features.definition: Natural log of one plus the memory's WordPiece count, including its source header.

features.name: position
features.definition: Nonnegative turn index divided by the maximum index in the eligible history; denominator at least one.

candidate_pool.rule: union of BM25 and semantic top-N

memory_unit: User turn plus following assistant messages; source text and roles preserved.
preprocessing: Apply the model JSON's training means and scales in its declared feature order.
scope: Only rank eligible evidence. The host enforces permissions, validity, mandatory evidence and its own tokenizer budget.
